links.text:
we made the simplest & cheapest cloud computer for agents that can still do complex work:

box "--type small"

at $0.000,005/s for 2vCPU, 4GB ram, 40GB nvme

it can even run chrome while streaming its desktop at 30fps!

and the best power for cost deal in the sandbox market: 

box "--type large" 

at just $0.07/h for 8vCPU 16GB w/ 100gb nvme

it can run minecraft, have chrome open, all while streaming itself at 60fps!

the cherry on top:

you can stop/resume or fork any box of any type into any other type, conserving all files, in just a few seconds

learn more at https://docs.ascii.dev/box/machines

links.title: Sandbox sizes: CPU, memory, disk - boat
links.description: The four sandbox sizes with their vCPU, RAM, disk and price per hour, how to pick one, and what every sandbox can do: root, Docker, systemd, no GPU.
